# 04-hardware

Hardware safety requirements, design, metrics, component qualification.

Standard clauses: 26262-5, 26262-8 §13, HWE.1–4.

![The 7 work products of this folder, one row each, with a chip at every gate G0 to G6 it is needed for, coloured by its status in the WP-M-00 register: 6 at G3, 1 at G4; 7 draft](index-status.svg)
